answer: How they went. Right: desktop south east to 200 (51, 135, 194); Escape causing the drop, the views changing nothing, 2 items at about 10; no drop on Add Item then Escape; a Shape at the same row stays, one above stays; the phone's one step; 26 is the stop by 400. Wrong: phone south east's second step, 62 not 56, and a phone move, 14 and 62 not 46; Back doesn't drop; a Shape lower in other columns moves, and one overlapping moves on Add Item; desktop south east's last step, 286 not 253. Within 1: phone 6 and 4 wide. Desktop 22 wide landed at 21 wide, so its numbers aren't a test; the stop at 26 held. Pushed at c283dc3, 2ea0093 and fc8b9d2, each before its reads.

CAP-X13SEL2.a box touching the selected block itself: It keeps its toolbar and handles while held, no label. On release it alone stays selected.
CAP-X13SEL2.a selected block, box on the second: The first keeps its toolbar and handles, the second is selected with its label. Pointer past the second: the label goes, the outline stays. On release the second alone, with Edit.
CAP-X13SEL2.nothing selected, box on the second: No toolbar or handles, the label shows. On release the second alone, with Edit.
CAP-X13SEL2.a group selected, box touching nothing: Group toolbar and handles stay while held, and on release.
CAP-X13SEL2.a group selected, box on one member: Group toolbar and handles stay while held. On release that member alone.

CAP-X13SEL3.a group, a box touching nothing, release: Read once in CAP-X13SEL2 as no toolbar or handles, unexplained. I expect the same on a fresh group: both blocks ringed, nothing else, until a click.
CAP-X13SEL3.a group, a box on one member and off it,: While on it the group toolbar and handles stay. Off it and released: as above.
CAP-X13SEL3.one block selected, a box in the next se: It keeps its toolbar and handles and stays selected on release.

CAP-X13SEL4.a group of two, a box on a member and a: Those two as a group on release.
CAP-X13SEL4.one block, a box on it and another: Those two as a group on release.
CAP-X13SEL4.the rings left after a group and an empt: Nothing is selected behind them: a click on empty canvas or on a block ends them. A second click on the same block selects it.
CAP-X13SEL4.one block, a box in the next section tou: It keeps its toolbar and handles while held and on release.

CAP-X13SEL5.a group of the outer two, a box on the m: The middle one alone on release, and the group keeps toolbar and handles while held.
Those two as a group on release.

predicted4.score: Right: the box on the selected block, on a second, with nothing selected, a group held, what ends the rings, the next section. Wrong: a group and an empty box released, which I expected kept (rings only). A group and a box on a member released: I expected the member alone, it stays the group. A group and a box on another: I expected that block alone, then those two; it takes in all three.

CAP-GROUPBAR.two or three shapes, nothing overlapping: 4 buttons: Stack Blocks, Align Group, Duplicate, Remove. Forward and Backward not there.
CAP-GROUPBAR.two that overlap each other, nothing els: Forward and Backward not there or both off: nothing outside the group to pass. Least sure of this one.
CAP-GROUPBAR.two with a third over a member: All 6, as GROUPRESIZE.json. Forward on, or off by z.
CAP-GROUPBAR.on a phone: Not sure a group can be made there; if it can, the same rule.
